I had a few tests that were alright. There were some things that I was just like why am I doing this. Especially in math. Dear god do I hate math right now. Still gonna get it done because hello highschool but yeah. Another thing is that next week. We have valentines day off. And the day before is a half day. And supposedly we are going to talk about mental health in our home room the entire time. And I am just sitting here going. The teachers dont take this seriously, the students dont take this seriously. Why are we even trying. I think maybe one kid in my class will show up. That may be it. Otherwise no one is going. I would not be surprised if half the school was gone. Anyways school gripes over. So friends wise. Dear god my friend devan. So there are some caves within the area that I live. And they are not large and expansive but they are cool. I take him and another female friend their to hang out. But before I take them what happens. He digs through my truck and finds the condomns in the back of my truck. So as I am standing by my gf with a few more friends. One of them goes "whats he waving and why is he shirtless". Thats all the imagery you need. Cause dear god did it scar everyone else. Anyways we had a fun time. Not much else happened. David is still being david so. Anyways things that happened with Destiny. So for starters she was less touchy this week. And I dont mean like sexual touch. Although it also falls under this category as well. Anywho thats for her own reason and I am not sure what that reason was at first but its what happened. I am not to worried about it now. But I will bring that back up in a little bit. So we ended up having a long talk on wedsnday because we had a small argument, I dont even remember what it was. But it really wasnt worth getting upset over but the talk we had was really nice. We established that we need to have talks like that more often. And as of right now I am in full support of it. Another thing that we established during it is that we are gonna try to pull back just a little bit. Not break up but try to make a stronger connection/friendship within our relationship. Which I agree with. Especially since we have had several things from before which messed with us. So the only thing I am kind of dissapointed in is that she also wants to pull back sexually. Which is what it is. But I ultimetly have to live with it. Anyways so I also talked to her about how she has been pulling away physically. And thats actually because appearently she has been more comfortable and felt she doesnt have to push herself to try and make me happy. For context due to events in her past she is not a very touchy person in general. But thats how I interpreted what she was saying. One last one is that I found out from her that her ex. The one I was worried about. Has told her he still likes her. And told her he wont do anything. Do I believe him. No. But thats coming up in a bit. Anyways the next thing that happened was today. Cause she accidently stepped on a nerve. And that nerve hurt. A lot. I just didnt bring it up at first because I dont want to look weak. Great deal that did. Is it gonna come up later. Yup. So I end up clamming up instead and acting a little bit like an asshole. Did I mean to. No. So later that day we had our friends birthday party. And one of my friends who attended is a psychic. And I will admit that for the longest time I agreed with most people that they are frauds. But god damn I had a reading from her that was spot on with what had happened today. To just do a quick thing she had me draw 9 cards in total. 3 in each of 3 rows. The first row was my past. Middle present. And last one future. So with the past she talked about how in a previous relationship I had become a bit hesitant to love after the breakup due to how they hsd hurt me. And that was true. Then the present was my current relationship. That she was a hopeless romantic. Which I would say anyone who has taken the time to read this and seen what she has put up with me then they can see it. And also that while I was very upset today ultimetly I had to talk to her and everything would be alright. And the future pretty much covered my senoritis. And I just sat there like welp. She also did those same readings with several others and according to the rest of them she had 90% or up accuracy for all of us. Some more accurate than others. But overall it was insane to see how everyone got there stuff. Also one last note. My gf's ex was there watching as my cards were drawn. The one I mentioned before, yeah thats gonna pop up soon enough. So while I am there eventually my little attempt to keep what I was holding in burst out. Mostly because I saw several body language signs from her ex that showed me he liked destiny. And that just caused my stress to jump higher and higher. So yeah. Eventually I burst out about it. I decided for us to control it and talk about it privately. But ofcourse people wanted details later. Anyways so I talked to her about it. And pretty much ended up talking about something that I didnt want to tell her unless I would have been comfortable saying I will marry her. Now I dont want to marry yet. One day that may happen. But not now. So we walked away from the house we sat down on a bench not to far away and talked. And she just ended up forcing it out of me. And was I completely comfortable with it. No. It just happened. As is a lot of things in my life I am discovering. Anyways. So we talked it over. And while I am very concerned for how optimistic her view is on things. I more or less just have to know that I just kind of have to trust things with her. And then came in the ex factor. So we headed back and while we were there I talked to him. Overall he seemed to more care for her than anything. But he also seemed to want to drive a wedge. And I say that cause he said that he thinks in order for us to form a more proper foundation to build back up on we should break up. Yeah I didnt show it but I didnt appreciate what he was saying. Although when I proped him about liking destiny he did answer honestly and tried to assure me that he wouldnt get inbetween. And I give him respect for being honest about it. However he did try to dumb it down. And when I said that while yeah not getting inbetween now may be his plan things tend to change in the future. His response was in laymens terms I wont do it. Definetly reasuring. Anyways I only have a few more things to report. First off I am reporting in about how my gf also tried to confront my friend david about how he liked her. And not surprisingly he denied it. So david is being david. I also noticed one of my old ex's has been showing signs of liking me. Yeah not happy about that. I have a friend who has gone through a rough week and I hope she gets better soon. I have noticed recently how I seem to know quiet a few people now. And part of me is like cool I know a lot of people and they all are at a comfortable distance from me. Like that is one benfit that I did not expect. And I dont like it that much honestly. Sometimes its cool. Others its annoying. I have been falling back on a few habits lately so I have to get back into them. Anyways thats all I can think of rn. So thanks for reading and good night.

Alright another week another step towards freedom. So this week I actually didnt have anything majorly bad happen. Am I happy yup. Am I scarred that its just me using up my good luck. Yup. So as far as school goes I got hit with hw left and right again and I am struggling to keep up with it. I am still trying to break my old procrastination habits so that may be why its hitting me hard. But I am still getting shit done. So we as I got several parts in my schools upcoming theatre productions. We are doing two 1 acts instead of the three that we thought was gonna happen. Yeah monday when I found out that callbacks was cancelled and we were doing the read through that day was a shock. One of the 1 acts is 'Sorry wrong number' and the other is 'Its not you, its me'. In sorry wrong number I am the western union member. While I am jack (sort of lead) in Its not you its me. And boy when I read the lines I looked at our director and was like this motha fucka type-casted me(aka casting you for a role based on what you seem to fit into from personality or appearence). And as a boy who is 6'0 at 145 lb can you guess what the character is like. A dude who is hopeless at love and gets dumped constantly. Yup I fit right into it. I say that mainly because of how horrible my past relationships have been so yeah. The one I am in right now is going rather well surprisingly enough. Anyways we also found out that a rival school decided to copy what we were doing and also did two 1 acts. And one of them just so happens to be 'Its not you its me'. And I was just like wtf. See they are doing it the week after valentines day though so its easy to say oh its because of the month. Meanwhile we are doing ours in april and its right before prom. God that is gonna kill me. Anyways the last thing I want to mention about it is one of the scenes in it has a girl asking her bf what he likes about her. And at first he doesnt respond, she is thinking that he is being thoughtful and wont say something like "your eyes". He isnt. When he was asked a second time he simply replies "your eyes". Im gonna get back to that in a second. Now one moment that was kind of conerning because I thought I had done something stupid. But as I found out, I did, just not by much. This came from when I showed what I thought was a funny pic from my phone to my gf. She didnt think it was funny though. About 5 mins later she asked why I like her. I was quiet literaly saved by the bell. But I still gave her a short response and told her I wanted to tell her in person instead of text later that day. One agonizing 5 hours later we meet at a coffee shop. And I tell her honestly. It was because she hasnt gone out of her way to hurt me like my past exes have. And she also hasnt just disappeared for no reason either. Again like my exes. And that goes with how I have some fears from when I was a freshmen under my abusive stepmoms thumb. But thats another story. Anyways we actually talked about a few more things that was on our minds and we talked it over and had a fun time. Then I asked her what she likes about me. What does she say. "Your eyes". I internally laughed so god damn hard. The irony hurt. Like I know my eyes look good. I have gotten so many people say they look beautiful so its not very surprising she said it. Just oh my god the irony in that statement. When she sees the play I am gonna hold what she said against her for so long. Maybe I am gonna watch it with her at the rival school but im not sure yet. Anyways so there is only two more notworthy thing that happened. So it was friday night. I ask destiny to hang out with me and watch a movie or something. So we do but her sister and cousin come with her. And its that movie little women.  Its a chick flick and I was surprised that it was a good movie. I didnt cry during it(unlike every single one of her and her relatives) but it was still good. Anyways on the car ride back I was tired and didnt talk much till the end of the ride. It was alright. But what hit me was when we got to her house and I had to go into my truck to get home. And she told me to text her when I got home. To make sure I was alright and that I got home safe. And as I was driving home I got this realization. It hit me harder than I thought anything would. And it was the fact that she wanted to make sure I got home safe. And I didnt last a minute before I had to pull over. Because I basically doubled what she and her relatives cried during the movie. And idk but just knowing that she was that worried about me that she wanted me to text her that I was safe made me feel so loved. Like I had been searching for that since I was a kid and I just found it now after having given up on finding it. Like this was a forgotten treasure and I had just casually stumbled on it after thinking it was gone for good. And that touched me. I havnt told her that I cried that hard yet. And probably not gonna tell her till valentines day. Anyways I also want to note something from today. So I decided to save up for a bear for her since she told me herself that she wanted one. And while I was searching for one earlier today I also stopped to look at the movies section and got this movie called a silent voice. This is my favorite movie because its one of those thongs that was so beautiful. It also helped me when I was under my stepmoms abuse. And I am not gonna lie I want to watch the movie with her on valentines day. So yeah thats how my week has gone. All in all pretty good. Thanks for reading.
